name: LAICIs - WorkBuddy Autonomous Forensic Agent

stages.name: Goal & Input Decomposition
stages.action: Inspect input MIME type, compute SHA-256 evidence hash, extract user goal and Malaysian context.

stages.name: Dynamic Tool Planning
stages.action: Construct tool execution DAG based on input modality (media vs. url vs. text).

stages.name: Parallel & Sequential Tool Invocation
stages.action: Dispatch registered WorkBuddy forensic and threat intelligence tools.

stages.name: Cross-Model Verification & Quality Control
stages.action: Verify evidence consistency, detect model discrepancies, enforce SSRF network security.

stages.name: Forensic Score & Context Fusion
stages.action: Calculate weighted multi-model confidence and cross-reference scammer database.

stages.name: Usable Outcome & Limitation Disclosure
stages.action: Generate executive findings, honest model limitations, and official escalation steps.

stages.name: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) RM Exposure Quantification
stages.action: Calculate exposure in RM, 25% prevention value, risk tier (LOW/MOD/HIGH/CRITICAL), and NSRC 997 playbook.
